correctness.rationale: The companion-matrix 7-step lifting gives the unique 4 mod 7 root. A uniformly convergent 2-adic binomial interpolation of the 5 mod 7 difference factors as 2uH(u); integral falling-factorial coefficients make H an exact isometry, and its first eight matrix coefficients establish H(0)=32 modulo 64. Two disjoint 2-adic root balls yield exactly 64 matching indices from the second branch once the modulus is at least 2^12; adding index 4 gives 65. The complete low-power formula and the minimal period are independently derived. The included check.py has passed complete finite counts through 2^12 and matrix/valuation checks.

It exhibits two different 2-adic zero mechanisms, initially growing modular coincidences and a sharp permanent stabilization at 65, despite exponentially increasing period. This is not a marginal valuation or a routine reformulation of the first-order individual-sequence results.
